run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test/Mock wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching for gtest or gmock
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to copy each .wiki file with a version prefix via svn cp
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update links in branched wiki files using WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to rewrite internal wiki links to the versioned prefix
use_DropWikiSuffix: use DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename string
